# truenas_smb_share (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS SMB share by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SMB share name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `abe` (Boolean)
- `acl` (Boolean)
- `audit` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `browsable` (Boolean)
- `comment` (String)
- `durablehandle` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `guestok` (Boolean)
- `home` (Boolean)
- `hostsallow` (List of String)
- `hostsdeny` (List of String)
- `id` (Number) Numeric SMB share ID.
- `locked` (Boolean)
- `path` (String)
- `purpose` (String)
- `recyclebin` (Boolean)
- `ro` (Boolean)
- `streams` (Boolean)
- `timemachine` (Boolean)
- `timemachine_quota` (Number)
- `vuid` (String)
